inputs.text: It is dark, and it is raining hard. In the clouds, you can see the outlines of a cloaked man. You hear it beating on shutters, though you cannot see any. A man’s hand reaches out of the dark, lifts a child and holds it against his shoulder, and then both of them are gone. Somewhere a slow tune climbs three notes and settles home again. It is whispering, at the very edge of hearing, and what it whispers is your name.
